assets.description: Native image generation: continuous rust-red Ashfall cloud panorama with one low sun, distant wreckage and mountains confined to the lower skyline. Replaces the previous visible splice; renderer now samples camera ray angles.
Native image generation: seamless diffuse top-down compacted basalt dust and iron-rich brown sand, sparse fine stones, restrained variation without tracks or a tile grid.

processing: Generated originals copied unchanged. Runtime Canvas decoding supplies power-of-two textures and mip levels; no generated source pixels edited offline.
